scope: Three new model-agent review/implementation rounds, numbered 7–9; technical review, not human peer review

decisions.finding: Publisher, practitioner, entity and original session are conflated by naive counts.
decisions.decision: Keep separate IDs, inherited source edges and unresolved attribution; expose all 106 candidate identities without asserting verified-human coverage.

decisions.finding: Raw captions and model weights are absent; source collection is denied by outbound policy.
decisions.decision: Preserve one blocked ordinary preflight and zero successful new collections; distinguish the 590-query plan from results. Continue frozen-source analyses.

decisions.finding: Available question/answer fields are AI digest paraphrases in one practitioner context.
decisions.decision: Release a typed digest-candidate SQLite/JSON/CSV database, null timestamps and unknown answer speakers; withhold cross-practitioner answer comparisons.

decisions.finding: Null publisher IDs collapsed seven unrelated publisher names into one group.
decisions.decision: Separate 27 resolved IDs from seven unresolved-name groups and disclose 105 candidates without resolved publisher ID.

decisions.finding: Generic query/stratification descriptions and prospective wording exceeded actual implementation.
decisions.decision: Describe exact three name templates plus entity combinations, deterministic caption selection, and exploratory post-schema planning; record precise TF-IDF settings.

decisions.finding: Dependent cosine pairs and pooled keyword summaries can hide account composition.
decisions.decision: Add equal-account and leave-one-account-out diagnostics; distinguish six zero medians from the single observed sign reversal. Treat permutation output as a descriptive negative control.

decisions.finding: Negative-control legend collided with its observed reference line in the rendered manuscript.
decisions.decision: Move labels, regenerate the affected figure, copy it into the paper and inspect final pages.

decisions.finding: High question cosine and low answer cosine invite false agreement/contradiction claims.
decisions.decision: Add 12 explicitly model-assisted paired readings with source pointers; keep answer agreement undetermined and recording independence unknown.

decisions.finding: A single question-neighbor cutoff and a 100-row preview hide retrieval sensitivity and pair concentration.
decisions.decision: Report cutoffs 0.40–0.90, 71 upload pairs, 30/127 matches in the top three upload pairs, and full 127-row download separately from previews.

decisions.finding: CSV serialization erased false booleans and prefixed null blanks.
decisions.decision: Preserve literal false and true missing blanks while separately escaping formula-like strings; validate exported rows against source types.

decisions.finding: A reserved empty .git path could reject the external raw directory, and caption-window boundaries/provenance were underspecified.
decisions.decision: Recognize actual Git metadata, preserve inherited identity keys, validate finite ordered segment times, enforce whole-segment end caps and maximum overlapping end; test with labeled synthetic fixtures only.

decisions.finding: PDF timestamps and ZIP metadata change artifact hashes between builds.
decisions.decision: Use a documented fixed source epoch and ZIP metadata; compile a clean source package and verify repeatability and extracted text.

decisions.finding: A desktop screenshot alone does not verify navigation, filtering, source downloads or narrow layouts.
decisions.decision: Exercise five views at desktop/narrow widths, filters, empty states, CSV scope, keyboard forms/disclosures, 200% CSS zoom and downloaded artifact byte equality.

decisions.finding: Shared Data runtime/reference and Sites deployment/source identity are unavailable in this checkout/toolset.
decisions.decision: Extend and browser-test the existing static app; disclose the runtime limitation and leave hosted deployment explicitly unperformed.
